baseline_models.mechanism: The paired first-person plural verbs join reversal of death to durable fixation: persons are restored while what they did remains available for judgment rather than dying with them.

activation_trace.role: Possession of animacy supplies the state restored by نحي and makes revival a reversal of lost life.
Loss of force and life supplies the terminal condition that the preceding verb reverses.
Fixation that entails judgment or decree makes writing an operative preservation, not casual notation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah separately promises resurrection and says that deeds are recorded.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection and evidentiary preservation form one mechanism: death does not erase either the actor or the action's judicial availability.

baseline_models.mechanism: The object pair distinguishes what agents intentionally place ahead from signs and paths that remain after them, so the writing captures both intervention and downstream wake.

activation_trace.role: Forward movement and precedence give قدموا a directional role: acts are projected ahead of their makers.
A surviving sign that indicates a prior event supplies the durable aftermath paired with forward action.
Following a predecessor's track makes an أثر a traversable route that can recruit later movement.
Joining one thing to another makes the record a dossier coupling initiating acts with their residual effects.

changed_reading.before: The record contains deeds and a second category called traces.
changed_reading.after: The record is causal and directional, coupling what a person sends forward with the signs, routes, and effects that continue behind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
baseline_models.mechanism: Totality is made countable and organized inside a clear origin, reference, and guide; the container is therefore a master index that exposes relations among items rather than a heap of entries.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing all parts supplies the claim that no component falls outside the register.
Whatever can be known and reported supplies the maximally general class of indexed objects.
Counting with exhaustive acquisition makes enumeration both quantitative and epistemically comprehensive.
An origin, gathering center, and reference supplies the register's organizing center.
A leader, book, road, or construction guide supplies an authoritative pattern by which entries can be followed.
Disclosure through speech, writing, or sign makes the master index readable and evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: Everything is stored in a clear book.
changed_reading.after: Everything is exhaustively indexed in an authoritative, legible reference-pattern that orders and reveals the relations among things.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated front/behind constructions turn قدموا and آثارهم into opposite sides of a traversed causal field: agents put acts before themselves while leaving consequences and followable tracks behind, even when perception of that field is blocked.

activation_trace.role: Advancing to the front supplies the forward pole of the focus pair.
A remaining indicator of what was supplies the rearward residue of the focus pair.
The idiom between the hands supplies an explicit frontward zone in which movement can be obstructed.
Barriers that close a gap make front and rear into bounded regions whose paths can be hidden.
What lies behind supplies the explicit rearward counterpart to between the hands.
The repeated frontward idiom makes the spatial pairing a surah-level organizing cue rather than a local accident.
The repeated behind-position stabilizes the second pole as aftermath and exposure.

structural_cues: 36:9 places barriers both between their hands and behind them, then states that they do not see.
36:45 repeats the paired warning about what is between their hands and what is behind them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated front/behind zones, hands, barriers, and the focus roots for advance and trace; I assign قدموا to frontward deposit and آثار to rearward wake. A live alternative reads both zones temporally as prior and coming consequences rather than spatially.

changed_reading.before: Prior deeds and later effects are two temporal entries.
changed_reading.after: They are the front and rear of one causal passage: action is placed ahead, while a readable wake remains behind and may guide or expose others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The town narrative stages a relay in which a sent message is followed, carried by purposeful movement, voiced publicly, and offered for further following; an أثر can therefore be a social route that survives its initiating speaker.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of a report until it becomes received tradition supplies the durable verbal trace.
Movement on a predecessor's track supplies the mechanism of imitation and relay.
Purposeful motion toward an objective makes the man's arrival an enacted extension of the message.
Speech that circulates among people supplies the propagating medium of the trace.
Tracing أثر after أثر makes the command to follow a literal social continuation mechanism.
Messenger and message name the dispatched content whose reception can generate a chain of followers.

structural_cues: 36:13-21 moves from dispatched messengers to a man arriving from the city's farthest point and urging others to follow them.
36:25-27 lets the man's voiced commitment outlive the confrontation and turns his concern back toward his people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending, purposeful movement, public speech, and explicit following; I infer a causal arrow from one reception to later uptake, so the focus trace includes propagated conduct. A live alternative limits آثار to the man's own steps and words without subsequent imitation.

changed_reading.before: Traces are unspecified residual consequences of deeds.
changed_reading.after: Traces include transmissible speech and modeled conduct that move through a community after the first speaker's action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dead-earth sequence renders revival as restoration of productive capacity: a dormant substrate is enlivened, hidden grain emerges, and fruit and further growth become its آثار. Resurrection is thus not bare animation but release of an interrupted causal yield.

activation_trace.role: Earth living through rain and vegetation supplies the focus verb with a productive ecological image.
Unworked dead land supplies a reversible kind of death whose contrast is renewed usefulness.
Soft productive earth supplies the material substrate in which restored life becomes visible.
The explicit dead-earth occurrence realizes the focus branch as an observable state rather than abstraction.
The repeated revival verb directly converts dead land into a producing system.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence as the first output of revival.
A seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies a compact carrier of continuing effects.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the downstream yield by which revived capacity is known.
Intentional work places human action inside the productive chain whose outputs are recorded.
Vegetation emerging from earth generalizes the revived field into a repeatable growth process.

structural_cues: 36:33 repeats the focus's dead/revive pair and immediately sequences emergence, grain, and eating.
36:34-36 expands the output chain through gardens, water, fruit, hands' work, and all that earth causes to grow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dead earth, revival, emergence, seed, fruit, work, and growth; I infer that productive outputs function as the revived substrate's traces. A live alternative treats the sequence solely as an analogy proving bodily resurrection, without importing productivity into the focus wording.

changed_reading.before: Reviving the dead means restoring animation to lifeless persons.
changed_reading.after: Revival restores suppressed productive capacity, and the record follows that return through the harvest of effects it releases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured stations, stable destinations, and non-colliding cycles activate the clear imam as a coordinate-pattern: enumeration can preserve where a moving thing belongs along its path, not merely whether it exists.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive counting supplies the quantitative operation needed to track stations and cycles.
A guiding book, road, or construction line supplies the master pattern for ordered trajectories.
Continuous flowing motion supplies a trajectory rather than a static inventory item.
Fixity and settled position supply an assigned destination within the moving system.
Deliberate apportioning and planning supply the rule that coordinates motion and station.
A station or rank supplies discrete positions through which the lunar path is indexed.
Ancient elapsed time supplies historical depth inside the recurring measured cycle.
Each member under an encompassing whole makes the ordered system distributive as well as total.
The celestial course supplies the spatial track on which each indexed body moves.
Running or swimming supplies sustained motion within, rather than outside, the assigned course.

structural_cues: 36:38-39 joins running, a settled destination, apportioning, lunar stations, return, and antiquity.
36:40 prevents one cycle from overtaking another and places each member in a course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured stations, destinations, recurring age, and distinct courses; I infer that الإمام is a master coordinate-pattern capable of locating trajectories. A live alternative keeps it a judicial ledger and uses the cosmic sequence only as evidence of exhaustive knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The clear imam is a static comprehensive ledger.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as a calibrated master map that indexes moving entities by course, station, sequence, and recurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carrying of descendants in a filled vessel and the creation of further mounts activate آثار as embodied legacy plus the material carriers that move it beyond the originating generation.

activation_trace.role: A surviving remainder that indicates prior existence supplies legacy as an embodied sign of predecessors.
Following a prior route supplies intergenerational continuation along an inherited path.
What is carried in lineage supplies descendants as a continuity borne beyond their predecessors.
Smallness coupled with dispersal supplies a branching image for descendants spreading from an origin.
A vessel moving through water supplies the material carrier of intergenerational continuity.
Filling and loading make continuity depend on a carrier stocked with living consequence.
Composing one thing into another supplies designed conveyances as extensions of human reach.

structural_cues: 36:41 names their descendants as what is carried in the filled vessel.
36:42 extends the carrying pattern to created analogues that people ride.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descendants, carrying, a loaded vessel, and composed mounts; I infer that people leave آثار through both lineage and transport infrastructures that carry futures. A live alternative restricts the passage to divine rescue and does not classify either descendants or vehicles as the people's traces.

changed_reading.before: A person's traces are mostly intangible consequences or remembered signs.
changed_reading.after: Traces can also be embodied continuities and material carriers through which a generation's reach travels beyond it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering and exact recompense culminate in sealed mouths, speaking hands, and witnessing feet; the writing is activated as a distributed evidentiary dossier whose signs remain in agents and actions, not only in an external document.

activation_trace.role: Fixation that entails judgment supplies the dossier's legally operative record.
A remaining sign that proves what occurred supplies the evidentiary trace borne into judgment.
Joining dispersed items into one collected whole supplies the assembly of actors and evidence.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the adjudicative use of the collected record.
Intentional action supplies the conduct against which recompense is matched.
A seal and its imprint disable ordinary testimony while foregrounding an evidentiary mark.
Intelligible speech connecting parties turns the hands into direct reporting surfaces.
What the hands acquired ties bodily agency to the deeds now speaking through it.
A sign that itself bears witness makes the bodily remainder function as evidence.
The bodily foot supplies the organ that physically traversed and now attests to the path.
Acquisitive limbs supply bodily instruments whose own activity can remain legible.

structural_cues: 36:53-54 gathers everyone and limits recompense to what they used to do.
36:65 transfers testimony from sealed mouths to hands and feet concerning acquired conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, deed-matched recompense, sealing, speaking hands, and witnessing feet; I infer that divine writing is distributed through embodied and material signs as well as a separate register. A live alternative keeps the written record and limb testimony as two independent evidentiary channels.

changed_reading.before: God keeps an external ledger later consulted at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The ledger is also distributed through durable imprints of agency: bodies, paths, and acquisitions become a dossier capable of testifying.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah brackets the focus with a person who follows the reminder and a clear recitation that warns whoever is alive; revival acquires a present epistemic register in which life is capacity to receive warning and convert it into following.

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit and rescue supplies a non-metabolic dimension of the focus's reviving action.
Coming after and following supplies the behavioral response by which received warning becomes visible.
A reminder that makes something present supplies the stimulus to which receptive life responds.
The repeated reminder supplies the content explicitly identified with the clear recitation.
Reading and recitation supply the audible-textual vehicle by which warning reaches the living.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign makes the warning cognitively available.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the activating event rather than mere information transfer.
Life as operative good allows the explicit living addressee to activate a responsive sense alongside biological life.

structural_cues: 36:11 defines the effective addressee as one who follows the reminder and fears without seeing.
36:69-70 identifies the discourse as clear reminder and recitation whose warning reaches whoever is alive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, following, disclosed recitation, awakening warning, and an explicit living addressee; I infer that responsiveness is a present mode of life and nonresponse a death-like incapacity. A live alternative takes حي in 36:70 as no more than ordinary biological life.

changed_reading.before: We revive the dead refers only to future bodily resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing bodily resurrection, the wording also resonates with present restoration of receptive, warning-responsive life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence moves from decayed bone through first origination and a green-tree/fire transformation to willing command and immediate coming-to-be. This activates the exhaustive clear imam as a prospective specification from which a dispersed or degraded form can be reconstituted, not only a retrospective archive.

activation_trace.role: Fixation as decree or determination supplies a record that can govern outcomes prospectively.
Exhaustive acquisition by enumeration supplies enough specification for no component to be lost.
An origin, gathering center, and reference supplies the prospective source from which a whole may be restored.
A book or construction guide supplies a pattern capable of directing reconstitution.
Decay and worn remains supply the degraded state whose informational continuity is questioned.
Bringing a thing newly into existence supplies origination as the demonstrated reconstruction capacity.
The first beginning supplies the prior realization used as the model for renewed creation.
Fresh green growth supplies a living material state that can disclose an apparently contrary outcome.
Kindled fire supplies the latent transformed output drawn from the green substrate.
An obligating command supplies the executable transition from specification to outcome.
Will and intention supply the initiating selection of the thing to be realized.
Will directed toward a thing links the indexed object to prospective realization.
Uttered saying supplies the expressed command that mediates the transition.
A thing's occurring and becoming present in time supplies realization of the commanded specification.

structural_cues: 36:78-79 answers the problem of decayed bones by appealing to first origination and comprehensive knowledge of every creation.
36:80 supplies a cross-state transformation from green tree to kindled fire.
36:82 compresses willing, saying, and becoming into a directional sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decay, first origination, comprehensive knowledge, a counterintuitive material transformation, will, command, and becoming; I infer that the focus's fixed and exhaustive imam can function like a generative specification. The materially live alternative is a purely retrospective judicial ledger plus independent creative power.

changed_reading.before: The clear imam preserves a complete archive of what already exists and happened.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a complete generative reference by which a lost form can be called back into realized existence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary mapped inventory for ء ث ر, whose images concern outward emergence and stirring rather than the dominant lexical trace inventory. It remains valid as an explicitly supplied split-root activation anchored to آثارهم and coordinated with قدموا; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory resonance, never as a replacement etymology or lexical equation.

activation_trace.role: Forward advance supplies the initiating projection from which an outward wake can proceed.
Visible emergence and outward spread recast the trace as an emitted wake rather than only residue.
Stirring something from its place supplies a dynamic effect that moves other things after the initiating act.

changed_reading.before: Their آثار are static marks left after completed actions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their آثار are wakes launched by forward acts: effects stirred into motion and spreading outward from the agent.

strongest_changes: The forward-deed/remaining-trace pair became a front-and-rear causal field that includes routes others can follow.
Revival became productive restoration, visible in emergence, seed, fruit, and renewed capacity, while retaining bodily resurrection.
Writing became a distributed evidentiary dossier in which seals, hands, feet, acquisitions, and material signs can testify.
The clear imam became legible as an ordering pattern for trajectories and, more exploratorily, a generative reference for re-creation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly externalized the focus ayah's compressed relations: front/behind space, messenger-to-follower relay, dead-earth growth, calibrated celestial courses, carried descendants, embodied witnesses, responsive life, and first creation followed by commanded becoming.
remaining_uncertainties: The coordinate-pattern and generative-specification readings of الإمام are abductive and may reduce to an exhaustive judicial ledger.
It remains uncertain whether descendants and conveyances are themselves آثار or only analogies for effects that outlast an agent.
The responsive sense of life in 36:70 may coexist with, but should not displace, its ordinary biological sense.
The split-root outward-wake activation is deliberately contained as branch-supplied resonance rather than lexical derivation.
